verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents its own deletion and retrieval APIs for GDPR compliance, so programmatic deletion of user data is a first-party capability, though the evidence is a single thin mention. Nothing in the pack shows configurable data-retention periods. The 'Retention report' is a user-engagement analytics feature, and the warehouse retention notes describe Snowflake/Databricks settings rather than Mixpanel controls, so neither counts. missing for 10: configurable data retention windows/policies, details of deletion API scope and workflow (e.g., event vs. profile deletion, timelines), AI/MCP-accessible deletion controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
